episode_title: 81.5 Points of Pain: pjh5473 Flattens Cwmessi
episode_summary: pjh5473 posts the week's high score and beats Cwmessi by 81.5, while three managers lose games their own benches would have won. Plus rookie risers, two trades from a busy aaronyuhas, the bubble race, and Djax818 putting a nine-game streak on the line against pjh5473.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: 81.5. That's not a margin, that's a zip code. pjh5473 drops 150.66, the high score of the week, right on top of Cwmessi, who managed 69.16.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: Dak Prescott alone scored 35.9. That's roughly half of Cwmessi's entire team, from one quarterback.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: And that makes Cwmessi 1-21. Eleven straight head-to-head losses. Officially eliminated.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: Welcome to SEPA Dynasty Weekly. I'm Doc.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: And I'm Vinny, and somebody please go check on Cwmessi.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: Let's stay on that game, because it also produced the worst bench decision of the week. Cwmessi started DK Metcalf. DK Metcalf scored 0.7.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: Point seven! And sitting on the bench? Antonio Williams, 16.7. His own rookie! His own draft pick! 16 points lost on one click.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: In fairness, his optimal lineup only reaches 103.78. He loses either way.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: That's not fairness, Doc, that's a second insult.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: Closest game of the week: hogantim97 over aaronyuhas, 91.3 to 85.06.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: Ugliest close game I've ever seen. hogantim97 wins and still loses to the median. And he benched Calvin Ridley's 15.3 to start Jordyn Tyson, who gave him 1.5.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: It didn't matter, because aaronyuhas left enough on his own bench to flip that game. That's four straight losses for him.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: And Djax818? Nine straight. Beat cbrech by 8.94 while cbrech had Justice Hill's 15.6 on the bench and Mark Andrews putting up 3.4.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: rfrancella97 did the same thing. Ladd McConkey, 18.2 on the bench, Ja'Marr Chase started for 5.6, lost to kingdemi by 8.58. Per my count, that's three managers this week beaten by their own benches.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: Alright, the watch list. And I'm starting with the guy who beat rfrancella97. Jonah Coleman, kingdemi's rookie, pick 1.08. 32.9 points, started, top performer in his game.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: He'd been averaging 14.1 when he played. That's more than double. kingdemi had only started him twice before this week; I suspect that's about to change.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: Now the one that hurts. Fernando Mendoza, JoshWileczek's pick at 1.04. 22.88 points. On the bench. Never started once in this league.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: He'd averaged 8.07 before this, so the caution was defensible. But JoshWileczek is averaging 114.23 over his last 3 and has lost two straight. A quarterback in superflex who just did that is worth a real look.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: Emmett Johnson, stehr's rookie, taken at 3.04. Got the start, dropped 22.3, best player on stehr's roster this week.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: Prior average 9.54. That's a third-round pick turning into a starter right as stehr pushes for a bye.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: And the rich get richer. Djax818, nine-game win streak, has Ted Hurst III sitting on his bench. Rookie, pick 3.10, 20.1 points.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: Previously averaging 5.66. Not a must-start yet, but the best team in the league doesn't need him to be. That's what depth looks like.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: Last one, and kingdemi, I'm sorry. Jack Bech, 18.8 on your bench. You started Malik Washington for 5.6.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: Bech had averaged 4.17 before this. Nobody saw it coming. But if he does it twice, it's a trend, and kingdemi is clinging to the last playoff spot.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: Two trades this week, and aaronyuhas is in both. Quick note: grades use today's dynasty values, in hindsight.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: First, aaronyuhas sent Davante Adams to cbrech for Kaelon Black and Alec Pierce. aaronyuhas gets an A-minus, cbrech a C-plus.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: Look, cbrech is 14-8 and wants a veteran for the playoff run. I get it. But two pieces for one? The math doesn't love you, buddy.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: Second, stehr acquired George Kittle from aaronyuhas for Mason Taylor and TreVeyon Henderson. B for both sides. Nearly dead even.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: A tight end in a TE premium league for a contender? That's a smart push from stehr. And aaronyuhas, at 6-16, selling two veterans in one day? That's a rebuild, and honestly, good for him.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: The playoff picture. Djax818 has clinched a spot at 19-3. Cwmessi is eliminated. Six spots, two byes, three weeks left, which means six more results for everyone, counting the median.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: And look at the logjam: pjh5473, cbrech, and stehr all sitting at 14-8. Nobody has clinched a bye. Not even Djax818.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: The bubble is kingdemi at 12-10 holding sixth. rfrancella97 is 3 wins back at 9-13, hogantim97 is 4 back, though he's won three straight.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: rfrancella97, you get stehr next week. Start Ladd McConkey. I'm begging you.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: Next week's marquee matchup: one seed versus two seed. Djax818 against pjh5473.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: The streak versus the guy who just put up 150.66. Love it.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: Our simple form guide has Djax818 at 147.13 and pjh5473 at 140.75. Not a real projection, but the numbers agree with me. Djax818 makes it ten straight.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: Nope. Streaks end, Doc. pjh5473 snaps it, and I'll be insufferable about it all week.

lines.speaker: doc
lines.text: You're insufferable every week. That's been SEPA Dynasty Weekly. Set your lineups.

lines.speaker: vinny
lines.text: And check your bench before you hit save. See you next week.

fact_check.verdict: Every line matches the facts, so no corrections are needed. The derived comparisons hold: Dak's 35.9 is roughly half of Cwmessi's 69.16, and Coleman's 32.9 is more than double his 14.1 average.
